pages.title: Image Proportions
pages.text: Maintain aspect ratio preserves the original image proportions instead of stretching it to fill the screen.

pages.title: Image Proportions
pages.text: This setting belongs to the physical display, so linked screens can choose different proportions.

pages.title: Local Override
pages.text: Turn Local image override on to let one linked display use its own image.$(br2)Selecting images here then affects only this display.

pages.title: Local Override
pages.text: Other displays with the same Screen ID keep following the shared image.

pages.title: Follow the Network
pages.text: Turn Local image override off to show the network's current image again.$(br2)The override is useful for linked displays; it does not grant extra permissions or expose private library images.

pages.title: Your display
pages.text: Settings > Your display settings offers 8-512 block render distance.$(br2)It applies to all screens for you, saves on this device, and works for read-only viewers.
